crossRefs.note: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come…
It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of…
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against Yahweh his God…

translations.web: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
translations.bsb: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
translations.kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
translations.asv: For he of whom these things are said belongeth to another tribe, from which no man hath given attendance at the altar.
